fullContentHtml:
SSC CPO SI CAPF Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the exam date for the post of Sub Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2026. This recruitment was released for 1871 posts. Applications for the SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 10 September 2026, to 30 September 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 20 – 28 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SSC CPO SI CAPF Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 September 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 October 2026
  • Correction Date : 08-10 October 2026
  • Paper-I Exam Date : 20 – 28 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Female Candidate : 0/-
  • Correction First Time : Rs. 200/–
  • Correction Second Time : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
